title: Lentil-Like Fermented Balls Middle Eastern Chickpea Falafel Cazuela
description: A comforting dish that combines the flavors of a Middle Eastern chickpea falafel with the fermentation process of lentil-like fermented balls.

ingredients.name: Fermented chickpea paste
ingredients.notes: available at some Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine chickpeas, mozzarella balls, fermented chickpea paste, parsley, mint, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Blend until the mixture is well combined and slightly chunky.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small falafel-like balls.
Place the balls in a shallow dish or a large plate lined with parchment paper.
Allow the balls to ferment in a cool, dark place for 12-24 hours.
Preheat a large cazuela or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add a couple of tablespoons of oil to the pot and swirl it around to coat the bottom.
Add a layer of falafel balls to the pot and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the balls from the pot and set them aside on a plate.
Add a little more oil to the pot if necessary, then add the remaining falafel balls.
Cook the remaining balls for 5-7 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve the falafel balls hot, garnished with additional parsley and mint if desired.
